title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8749: AE2 AutoCrafter won't create Basic to Nitro Energy Cells

text:
[issue by Eevetv]
### Describe the bug

Problem:
When trying to autocraft any Energy Cell (Powah) above a Blazing Energy Cell it mentions missing ingredients. 

- When making the Blazing Energy Cell directly, shows all ingredients are available and can craft.
- When trying to making a higher tier than Blazing Energy Cell, ingredient breakdown does not show ingredients for Energy Cells equal or below than Blazing tier.
- Running a single AE2 network with 1 7x7x7 Quantum Computer
- I noticed when crafting some 

Screenshots for reference:

https://imgur.com/a/tUO99Sk


### How to reproduce the bug

How to Reproduce:
- Set up craft patterns for basic to nitro energy cells
- Set up craft patterns for all dependent parts for crafting cells
- Attempt to craft nitro energy cell

### Expected behavior

- Crafts all dependent parts including lower tier energy cells

### Additional details

_No response_

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge

### Crash log

No crash

[comment by Eevetv (none)]
Notice some serial differences:

Basic: 444 -- No secondary serial
Hardend: 677 -- No secondary serial
Blazing: 107 -- No secondary serial
Niotic - 410 -- Unable to verify if no secondary serial as it says I'm missing 2 Blaze when I already have them crafted.
Nitro: 706 -- Secondary serial: 296

[comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)]
Did you allow for substitutions in your Powah recipes? In particular in the niotic recipe? Maybe you have some variant with NBT data in your recipe that you cannot craft. Allowing substitution should fix that problem.

[comment by Eevetv (none)]
I will try this out. About to log in.

[comment by Eevetv (none)]
Thank you for suggesting this. Resolved!
